newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Aug 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Aug 13.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories Wednesday:
* The AFL-CIO plans to loan millions of dollars to the striking United Parcel Service Teamsters union.
* The American Medical Association will endorse Sunbeam products in exchange for millions of dollars of royalities.
* Across the U.S., home prices are rising.
* Hicks, Muse said it would buy LIN Television LINB.O.
* The U.S. said productivity rose slightly in the second quarter.
* The Dow Industrials fell 101.27 points to 7960.84.
* Bond prices fell for a fifth straight day.
* A portfolio manager of two big Janus funds resigned.
* Intel filed a counterclaim against Digital Equipment.
* President Clinton will order changes in the testing of prescription drugs to ensure drug makers specifically examine their effects on children.
* Republic Industries' legal battles with Toyota and Honda are weighing down the company's stock.
* The NASD plans to toughen the rules for small firms and brokers that trade on the over-the-counter bulletin board.
